title: world record
description: WORLD_SESSIONS_PLAN §2.1 (WS2): <world>/kantobridge/world.json, the games a world plays (one per world space) and its start region. Written by the creation flow and "Add a region"; read by the server (and sent in the world.regions document) and the client. A world without it is a legacy world: its games are its regions' games, start is slot 0's region.

start.description: The region whose town is the world spawn and whose game a fresh player follows first; one of games' regions.
